acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the snapshot carries orchestration waves or workflow runs, when the A8 view opens, then a node graph renders from that live data with node state encoded visually and no fabricated structure
Given the snapshot carries no orchestration data, when the A8 view opens, then an empty state names the missing feed instead of showing a placeholder graph

Given a rendered node, when it is selected, then the inspector shows its Task ID, assignee, and evidence links resolved from the snapshot, and an open-console affordance navigates to the A9 session of the assignee when one exists
Given the composed change is complete, when npm run lint and npm test run, then both exit 0 and the view is reachable through the A-domain navigation without breaking existing views
